summary.text: Ron Bryce is a Republican state representative from Kansas who has represented District 11 since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Ron Bryce's career experience includes working as a physician.
Bryce took office representing Kansas House District 11 on January 9, 2023, succeeding Jim Kelly.

In the 2025–2026 session he was assigned to the House Federal and State Affairs Committee and the Taxation Committee, served as vice chair of the Health and Human Services Committee, and sat on the Robert G. (Bob) Bethell Joint Committee on Home and Community Based Services and KanCare Oversight.
